quotes.text: Learn how to save Klarna details and charge your customers later.
This article has multiple variants. Fetch one of the following URLs to view specific content for your use case:

old_evidence.text: This guide isn’t for integrations that use [Stripe Billing](https://docs.stripe.com/billing.md). If you use Stripe Billing, see [Klarna for subscriptions](https://docs.stripe.com/billing/subscriptions/klarna.md).
To reuse a Klarna payment method for future payments, you must attach it to a *Customer*
When you charge the saved payment method, use the same subscription reference.

The example below includes optional details using [payment_method_options](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents/create.md#create_payment_intent-payment_method_options) to help improve Klarna underwriting and authorization rates.

findings: Semantic raw delta is navigation/presentation only: November new raw lines 5-18 retain purpose and route to Checkout, Direct API, iOS, Android and React Native variants; old raw lines 8-14 and 22-3751 contain the complete dated workflows. Diff lines 3-20 and 3752-3757 show replacement by an index, not evidence that any behavior was removed or deprecated. Add new raw provenance and identify it as an index in the mapped source, while retaining the May 2026 capture and its dated details.

Existing source line 13 omits old raw lines 14-18 scope: the full guide excludes Stripe Billing and Klarna payment options vary by use case and buyer country. This matters for selection of the right subscription guide and eligibility expectations; source line 21 currently says passing details 'unlock' Pay in 3/4 without the old raw lines 76-81 length/country qualification.

Existing source line 25 says 'pass' on_demand metadata as if obligatory. Old raw lines 281-287 explicitly call these optional payment_method_options details in the on-demand charge example; source should say optional and avoid guaranteed underwriting/authorization outcome.

Existing source line 23 labels return_url 'required' for off-session renewals, but old raw lines 230-237 say 'Specify a return_url' as part of this guide and provide a sample. Preserve this flow-specific instruction without turning it into an unconditional API requirement. Old raw lines 279-287 describe on-demand charge with off_session false (customer in checkout), contrary to a blanket off-session framing in source line 13.

Old raw lines 136-150 and 218-224 distinguish success_url/return from authorization: use webhook or retrieve Intent status, and save PaymentMethod only after succeeded. Source lines 17-29 lack this central boundary. New raw lines 9-18 establish no setup, payment or mandate lifecycle states, and variant targets were not fetched here.

Keep subscription reference consistency and mismatch error as a dated, conditional old-guide claim (old raw lines 83-87, 230-237), plus renewal line items, upgrade and mandate detach paths (old raw lines 230-277, 698-782).

Keep browser, native SDK and sandbox examples version/context qualified: Stripe.js dahlia in old raw lines 1032-1061, iOS 13+ in 1763-1765, Android example 23.7.0 in 2408-2428, React Native return URL conditions in 3118-3128 and sandbox-only country tables in 339-345. answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/klarna/set-up-future-payments, the complete November capture (new raw lines 5-18) establishes the purpose of saving Klarna details for later charges and lists Checkout, Direct API and iOS/Android/React Native variant URLs, but gives no steps or state transitions. The matched May capture (old raw lines 8-20, 41-43, 55-57, 218-237, 279-287) describes customer authorization, Customer-attached PaymentMethods, Checkout setup or PaymentIntent/SetupIntent paths, succeeded/failed Intent events, subscription renewals and on-demand use. The sole mapped source, source-stripe-klarna-set-up-future-payments.md, summarizes parts of that older guide at lines 13-29 but omits Billing exclusion, variable Klarna option eligibility and the webhook/status boundary; its metadata at lines 6-7 cites only the older raw.
answers.Q2: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/klarna/set-up-future-payments, the visible change is a navigation/index presentation (new raw lines 9-18; old raw lines 8-14 and 22-3751), not a demonstrated change to Klarna semantics or deprecation. source-stripe-klarna-set-up-future-payments.md should retain May-dated Customer attachment, reference matching, renewal, upgrade and revocation claims, while adding the November index as separate provenance. Its lines 21 and 25 need qualification from old raw lines 16-18, 76-87 and 281-287: Pay in 3/4 varies by country, use case and subscription length, and on_demand details are optional. The old guide's web, mobile SDK/version and sandbox examples stay dated; redirect or resource creation does not prove authorization or payment success (old raw lines 136-150, 218-224), while the new index cannot establish those outcomes.
